Source: https://github.com/ijry/uview-plus

Referenced files: src/uni_modules/uview-plus/components/u-tabbar/u-tabbar.vue and props.js. This project adapts the fixed navigation + safe bottom + content placeholder layout approach for its single-page storefront; it does not import the entire component library. The storefront's icons are locally drawn assets. Original library code has not been added as a runtime dependency.
